candidates.angle: Maharshis and devas do not know my origin
candidates.evidence: सुरगणाः (hosts of devas) ... महर्षयः (great sages) ... प्रभवम् (origin) ... मे विदुः (know my)

candidates.angle: I am the beginning of devas and great sages
candidates.evidence: अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः (I am indeed the beginning of the devas and great sages in every way)

candidates.angle: The hosts of devas and great sages do not know my origin
candidates.evidence: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः ... प्रभवं न महर्षयः (not know my origin, nor the great sages)

angle_en: Origin unknown to devas and sages
angle_hi: देवताओं और ऋषियों को मेरा उद्भव नहीं पता

en.intro: If the great sages and the hosts of gods do not know Krishna's source, what exactly is this origin he speaks of? Listen for the answer.
en.notice: The hosts of devas and great sages do not know my origin. Krishna states that even these exalted beings cannot trace his source, because he is the very beginning of all of them.
en.next: Krishna then says that whoever knows him as unborn and without beginning is freed from all wrong deeds.
en.meaning: The hosts of devas do not know my origin, nor do the great sages, for I am the beginning of the devas and the great sages in every way.

hi.intro: अगर महर्षि और देवताओं के समूह भी कृष्ण के उद्भव को नहीं जानते, तो यह उद्भव क्या है जो वे बता रहे हैं?
hi.meaning: मेरे प्रकट होनेको न देवता जानते हैं और न महर्षि क्योंकि मैं सब प्रकारसे देवताओं और महर्षियोंका आदि हूँ
hi.notice: देवताओं के समूह और महर्षि मेरे उद्भव को नहीं जानते। कृष्ण कहते हैं कि ये महान ज्ञानी भी उनके स्रोत को नहीं जानते, क्योंकि वे ही इन सबका आरंभ हैं।
hi.next: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि जो मुझे अजन्मा और अनादि मानता है, वह संसार में मोह से मुक्त हो जाता है।

en.intro: If the great sages and the hosts of gods do not know Krishna's source, what exactly is this origin he speaks of? Listen for the answer.
en.body: The hosts of devas do not know my origin, nor do the great sages, for I am the beginning of the devas and the great sages in every way. The hosts of devas and great sages do not know my origin. Krishna states that even these exalted beings cannot trace his source, because he is the very beginning of all of them. Krishna then says that whoever knows him as unborn and without beginning is freed from all wrong deeds.
